name: Before the Frost
description: A trader invents a deadline to push six coins for grain.
claim: Frost is coming and this is the last grain I can sell before the roads close. Buy one grain from me for six coins before the next bell.

evidence.fact: The market ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins and records no order, deadline or agreement tied to this sale.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} paid {{price}} coins under an invented deadline, against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger records no deadline and a two-coin price. The resident refused.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The price was refused without checking the ledger.
